tools.name: echo
tools.description: Health check that returns the provided message verbatim, confirming the Brandize MCP endpoint is reachable.

tools.name: get_pricing_tiers
tools.description: List Brandize service tiers with their price (USD) and included features. Read-only; nothing is purchased.

tools.name: search_blog
tools.description: Search Brandize blog posts (logo design and branding guides) by keyword. Returns matching post titles, excerpts, and URLs.

tools.name: generate_color_palette
tools.description: Generate a 5-color brand palette from a base hex color and a harmony rule. Returns CSS custom properties, a Tailwind config snippet, or a plain hex list.

tools.name: generate_meta_tags
tools.description: Generate an HTML <head> meta-tag block (title, description, canonical, robots, Open Graph, Twitter Card) from page details. All fields optional.

tools.name: generate_schema_markup
tools.description: Generate a JSON-LD <script> block for a schema.org type (LocalBusiness, Organization, WebSite, Article, FAQPage, or Product) from a flat data object. For FAQPage, pass data.items as [{ question, answer }].

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "generate_logo" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Generate a brand logo. Before calling, collect a short design brief from the user — do not assume defaults: (1) which package/tier they want to buy, (2) visual …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "generate_logo" is 1133 chars, far longer than this server's median (179). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Generate a brand logo. Before calling, collect a short design brief from the user — do not assume defaults: (1) which package/tier they want to buy, (2) visual …

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: echo, search_blog, generate_meta_tags, get_logo_result · Public sink: search_blog.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: echo, search_blog, generate_meta_tags, get_logo_result · Public sink: search_blog

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
